parsed_response.rationale:
The current low-level goals (LLGs) comprehensively cover the parent high-level goal (HLG) of 'Enable seamless payment and wallet management'. Each LLG is documentably supported, non-redundant, and correctly realizes the HLG through functional interactions or effects. The system allows customers to check their wallet balance, receive payment notifications, handle insufficient balances with grace periods, recharge wallets via in-store terminals or online transfers, and automatically cancel orders if necessary due to insufficient funds. No essential capabilities are missing, and there is no redundancy in the described actions.

The LLGs 'Check wallet balance and payment status' (llg_001), 'Receive payment notification' (llg_002), 'Handle insufficient balance with grace period' (llg_003), 'Recharge wallet via in-store terminal' (llg_004), 'Recharge wallet via online transfer' (llg_005), 'Trigger email warning for insufficient balance at order placement' (llg_006), 'Trigger SMS reminder for insufficient balance before Monday evening' (llg_007), and 'Automatically cancel order if wallet balance remains insufficient after Monday evening' (llg_008) all contribute to the seamless management of customer virtual wallets and payment processes.

The reconstructed HLG' accurately summarizes the essential functionalities of the LLGs. There are no unsupported or misleading LLG IDs, and there are no missing essential capabilities in this decomposition.
